dedupe_keys.name: application of genetic algorithm to a gas network for compressor speed optimization

description: The Java package optimises the speeds of six gas compressors using a genetic algorithm, minimising fuel consumption subject to delivery-pressure bounds. Flow rates remain fixed from an earlier flow calculation. The provider is Matthew Efe Takerhi. Coverage: It represents one configured gas-network example. Real-world geography, operating dates and time resolution are not established in the description. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. The public deposit provides a free access route; downstream software and third-party data may have separate conditions. Limitations: Fixed flows and the selected fitness function limit generalisation. This is distinct from P00506, which optimises flows; the two deposits have different DOIs and objectives. For simulation it provides a worked compressor-control optimisation case. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
